text: The work is complete. The changes expose `cmd_bump`, `cmd_check`, and `cmd_compare` as distinct public API entry points while maintaining full backward compatibility with existing functionality. All 166 tests pass.

raw_message.reasoning:

1. Added three new functions (cmd_bump, cmd_check, cmd_compare) before the process function
